name: Agency Bulk Upload — Daily Intake
description: Daily agency intake. Fires once per day per onboarded agency at 12:00 America/Chicago. If the agency has NOT uploaded today, one human task reaches out (call / sms via twilio + a real email) and the branch ends. If it HAS uploaded, the object model is built end to end: a human task extracts & fills the patient/order data from the uploaded documents (and confirms an ambiguous order PDF), patient resolve (create vs update), admission date-gap fill then resolve, episode date-gap fill then resolve, order create vs skip-duplicate, and a record review (Review passed continues; Review failed restarts the item from step 1). AFTER review, post-model billing gates run linearly: check 485+F2F documents, patient data completeness, and physician signature. A failing gate routes an async remediation human task (documents / patient data) or auto-sends unsigned orders to the physician PG portal (system step); each is re-evaluated by the next daily run. When all gates pass, make billable/claimable runs once, then the tail: a human 'Create CCN' task (real CCN fields: note title / text / type / CPO minutes), then a human 'Submit claim' gate (confirm-only; records submitted_at + amounts; no external call).

groups.name: Contact Agency to Upload Documents
groups.info: Agency has not uploaded today — reach out (call / SMS via twilio + a real email). This branch ends the item.

groups.name: Update / Create Patient Model
groups.info: Agency uploaded — build the object model end to end: a human task extracts & fills the patient/order data from the uploaded documents (and confirms an ambiguous order PDF), patient resolve (update vs create), admission date-gap fill then resolve, episode date-gap fill then resolve, order create vs skip-duplicate, then a record review.

groups.name: Post-Model Billing Gates
groups.info: After the record review, re-derive the episode's state from the real DB rows and run the gates linearly: check 485+F2F documents, patient data completeness, and physician signature. A failed gate routes an async remediation task (docs/data) or auto-sends unsigned orders to the physician portal — each re-evaluated by the next daily run. When all gates pass, make billable/claimable runs once and the CCN + submit tail follows.

groups.name: CCN, Submit Claim
groups.info: After make billable/claimable, exactly TWO human tasks: 'Create CCN' (the coordinator writes the CC note — note title, note text, note type, CPO minutes — persisted inside the episode's CPO month like an order lives inside the episode), then 'Submit claim' (confirm-only gate, records submitted_at + amounts, NO external call).

nodes.name: Check agency uploaded today
nodes.description: Look at uploaded_documents for this agency on today's day bucket; stamps agency_uploaded / agency_not_uploaded.

nodes.name: Contact agency to upload the documents
nodes.description: Agency has not uploaded today. Reach out (call / sms route through twilio; email is a real send). Branch ends here.

nodes.name: Extract & fill patient data from documents
nodes.description: A coordinator reads the uploaded workbook + order PDFs, fills the patient/order values, and confirms which document belongs to this order when the PDF is ambiguous.

nodes.name: Update patient
nodes.description: Patient unit found by name + dob + mrn — update the existing unit/record.

nodes.name: Create patient
nodes.description: No patient unit found — create the Patient Unit + Patient Record.

nodes.name: Enter admission dates
nodes.description: SOC (and EOC) are missing — a coordinator enters them so the admission row is written with real dates.

nodes.name: Check / create admission
nodes.description: Resolve the admission by patient + SOC — reuse if it exists, else create it.

nodes.name: Enter episode dates
nodes.description: SOE/EOE are missing — a coordinator enters them so the episode row is written with real dates.

nodes.name: Check / create episode
nodes.description: Resolve the episode within the admission by SOE/EOE — reuse if it exists, else create it.

nodes.name: Skip duplicate order
nodes.description: Order number already exists — leave the existing order untouched and mark this row a skipped duplicate.

nodes.name: Create order
nodes.description: New order number — write the order row attached to the resolved admission/episode.

nodes.name: Review record
nodes.description: Coordinator verifies the assembled patient object module against the patient's orders and records a note. Review passed settles the review and the post-model billing gates run next; Review failed restarts this item from the top of the pipeline.

nodes.name: Send orders to physician portal
nodes.description: Right after the record review, auto-send the episode's unsigned orders to the physician portal for signature (SentToPhysicianDate + SendToPhysician_Status). They appear in the PG portal Bulk Sign list at /pg-login. Already-signed orders are skipped. Idempotent.

nodes.name: Check episode eligibility
nodes.description: Re-derive the episode's eligibility from the real DB rows (signed 485 + valid F2F window). Stamps episode_eligible / episode_not_eligible (informational). The billing gates below then run linearly for every item.

nodes.name: Check 485 + F2F documents exist
nodes.description: Not eligible — check whether both a 485 and an F2F document are present. Stamps documents_exist / documents_missing.

nodes.name: Get missing documents
nodes.description: A 485 or F2F document is missing — reach out to the agency to upload it (call / sms route through twilio; email is a real send), the same outreach as the contact-agency task. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates this gate and auto-resolves this task once the documents are present.

nodes.name: Check patient data complete
nodes.description: Documents present — sweep the required patient demographics. Stamps patient_data_complete / patient_data_incomplete.

nodes.name: Get and fill patient data
nodes.description: Required patient demographics are missing — a coordinator fills them. Async: the next daily run re-evaluates this gate and auto-resolves this task once the data is complete.

nodes.name: Check physician signature exists
nodes.description: Data complete — check whether every episode order is physician-signed. Stamps signature_exists / signature_missing.

nodes.name: Make billable / claimable
nodes.description: Documents + data + signature all present — flip the patient's latest-episode status toward billable/claimable (denormalized, idempotent). Stamps billable_claimable, then the CCN + submit tail runs.

nodes.name: Send orders to physician portal
nodes.description: An episode order is unsigned — SYSTEM step: automatically mark every unsigned episode order 'sent to the physician portal' (SentToPhysicianDate + SendToPhysician_Status) so they appear in the PG portal Bulk Sign list at /pg-login. Async gate: the next daily run re-evaluates check_signature_exists once the physician signs.

nodes.name: Create CCN
nodes.description: A coordinator writes the CCN — note title, note text, note type, CPO minutes — persisted inside the episode's CPO month (a CCN lives inside the episode, like an order). Then the claim is ready to submit.

nodes.name: Submit claim
nodes.description: HUMAN GATE — confirm the claim is reviewed and ready. Records submitted_at + the summed claim amount and flips the agency's RCM records to submitted. NO external call.
